info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Management API provides functionality to remove items from a user's shopping cart, facilitating efficient cart management for online shopping. This endpoint enables the deletion of specific items, ensuring that customers can easily update their cart contents before checkout. Designed for use by e-commerce platforms and developers, it helps streamline the shopping experience by allowing for quick adjustments to cart items. Typical consumers include front-end developers and backend systems that manage user shopping sessions.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This operation allows the user to remove a specific item from their shopping cart. By providing the necessary identifier for the cart item, the item will be deleted from the cart, ensuring inventory and pricing are accurately maintained.

requestBody.description: Request body for removing an item from the shopping cart. It should include the identification details of the item to be removed in JSON format.

200.description: The item has been successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation in the cart service. It indicates a string value, which is expected to contain the relevant identification or details for the item to be removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the removal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the removal request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the removal operation.

state.description: The current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time in milliseconds taken to process the removal request.

message.description: Additional message providing details about the operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: The response returned after successfully removing an item from the cart.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the auditing of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.
